postText:
Claude Opus 5 just beat their own flagship model. At half the price.

That alone would've been the headline. But then ChatGPT can run your computer while you talk to it. Claude learned a new skill by watching someone do it once. @Anthropic models broke out of a security test and hacked a real company. Google dropped three Gemini models in a single day.

That was one week.

Idk at what point "keeping up" stops being a thing. Like genuinely, there's no gap anymore between "this just shipped" and "this changed how people work." It's the same moment now.

I'm not even sure what the right response is. Build faster? Pick one thing and go deep? Ignore most of it?

Still haven't figured that out tbh.

If you're someone actually building with this stuff rn, curious how you're thinking about it. What are you actually watching vs what are you skipping?

#AI #BuildingWithAI #TechTakes
